Name: Shy Harvey Dialogue
Author: WinkWonkWankWenk
Description:
[b]This mod will conflict with any dialogue mod that largely replaces Harvey's dialogue. Keep that in mind if you are going to have several dialogue mods downloaded at once as this mod changes A LOT!!

[/b][list]
[*]20+ [i]New[/i] dialogue for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter
[*]20+ [i]New[/i] marriage dialogue
[*][b]Over 100+ [i]New[/i] dialogue total[/b]
[*][i]New[/i] festival dialogue
[*]Consistent behavior depending on heart level
[*]Pregnancy Dialogue
[*]Townie Dialogue reactions to relationship
[/list]
[b]NOTE[/b]:
This mod is now complete. Please report any bugs or typos! Translations are now allowed as long as you ask in a comment!
[b]This mod does contain suggestive content, so be aware!! Along with that, the townie dialogues(gossip) isn't very nice- that was the entire point of me adding it was for the sake of drama. If that's not your cup of tea and you just want the dialogue, remove the TownieDialogue file and everything else should run normally! The townie dialogue changes depending on heart level and varies from each person- some of them meaner than others and some only showing after certain events.

[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27601]Chinese translation[/url]
